instruction: How much money have I been requested on Venmo in the last 10 days (including today)?
notes: Pure information-retrieval task: no database changes are allowed (evaluation asserts no model changes), so the only state predicates are credentials/token knowledge and the `found-requested-total` knowledge predicate. The answer amount is a runtime object computed by the agent from the received payment requests: filter by created_at within the last 10 days including today (2023-05-24 through 2023-06-02) and sum the `amount` fields; status is not filtered since the question asks how much was requested. The reference solution may call show_received_payment_requests more than once for pagination; the model collapses this into one logical lookup step. supervisor-complete-task takes the amount as its `answer` and is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on every other action.
